subject: Proposal: end-of-quarter pilot close incentive for FluxHealth
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara@fluxhealth.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Quick Q: pilot runway and next steps

Hi Olga —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The team is excited about the latency and cost numbers; engineering loved the cold-start behavior. We're finishing up a short internal exec review and there are two asks that came up: 1) Can we get a two-week trial extension on our pilot so we can validate the integration with our ETL? 2) Is there any one-time credit you can provide to offset initial token usage for the production-like tests?

Our budget owner (procurement) will want to see an illustrative MAP and a simple PO template they can use if we decide to convert. Can you send both?

Appreciate any help — trying to close by end of month.

Cheers,
Tara
Director of Data Platforms
FluxHealth

---
Attachment: (none)
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@fluxhealth.ai>
Date: 2027-09-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick Q: pilot runway and next steps — proposed incentive

Ben / Marissa —

Looping you both in. FluxHealth is asking for a two-week extension and a small one-time credit to get them over the finish line this month. They are a strong fit for our healthcare partner play and likely to expand to Dedicated next year.

My proposed ask: 45-day trial total (two-week extension) + $8k worth of token credits (applied as a one-time promo code) conditioned on signing an SOW/PO for a 6-month pilot at committed throughput (we estimate ~$45k ARR if they convert). This is a targeted close incentive only valid through 2027-09-30.

Attachments: I can send a simplified MAP and PO template to procurement once we confirm the credit.

Quick notes for approval:
- Giveaway size: $8,000 (promo credit)
- Accounting impact: one-time promo; not a refund
- Compliance: pilot data stays in hosted sandbox; no PHI ingestion contractually allowed during pilot

Ben — can you greenlight the credit? Marissa — any PO/accounting constraints I should flag (rev recognition, code redemption timeline)?

Thanks,
Olga
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Singh <tara@fluxhealth.ai>
Date: 2027-09-14T14:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick Q: pilot runway and next steps — proposed incentive

Olga —

Sounds reasonable. Approve the $8k promo credit for FluxHealth conditional on a signed PO for the 6-month pilot by 2027-09-30. Please add a clause that credits are non-refundable and expire 30 days after issuance. The customer commitment should be explicit in the PO: target tpm/throughput and expected monthly spend.

Marissa — flag if accounting needs a different flow, but from a quota perspective this is within the accelerator budget.

Ben
Head of Sales Ops

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Tara Singh <tara@fluxhealth.ai>, FluxHealth Procurement <procurement@fluxhealth.ai>
Date: 2027-09-16T17:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick Q: pilot runway and next steps — proposed incentive

All —

Quick accounting notes:
- Promo credit of $8,000 is fine. We will treat this as a contra-revenue promotion applied to the first invoice after conversion if they convert within the promo window; otherwise it's a one-time hosted-credit applied to their account (no cash movement).
- Please use the attached PO template (flux_po_template.docx) when procurement is ready. I also attached a short MAP (flux_q4_map.pdf) that shows the target milestones and conversion triggers.
- Need a short email from procurement confirming acceptance of the PO terms; once received, ops will provision the promo code and set the expiration.

Olga — please confirm exact wording for the conversion commitment (6-month pilot, minimum committed throughput: 2M tokens/month) and I'll ensure accounting tags it correctly.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
